text: {name} makes honest iron, and charges what it is worth.
{name} keeps a clean house and a quiet room, and knows everyone's business.
{name} drives a hard bargain but has never been caught cheating.
{name} is firm at the gate and takes no sides.
{name} works the land from dawn to dusk and has never missed a harvest.
{name} is trouble. Folk cross the road when they see them.
{name} can't be trusted with money, some say.
{name} never turned a hungry person from the door.
{name} has a temper, and people step carefully around it.
{name} is a quiet one who gives no trouble.
They say {name} is not as well off as they look.
{name} lost someone, and has not been quite the same since.
